nodes.label: Organiser IA + Data-Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Drill-down on the organiser web app navigation, per-module contents, and input/output flows; feeds task #8 design implementation and the M2 unfreeze scope.

nodes.label: Left sidebar app-shell + counted pill-tabs
nodes.rationale: witan/Cadre pattern - 8 nav areas outgrow the shipped 3-part top bar; two-level nav (sidebar global, tabs within-event); mobile bottom nav with Scan as the prominent center action.

nodes.label: Eight organiser nav areas
nodes.rationale: Dashboard, Events, Participants, Accreditation & Compliance, Check-in, Communications, Reports/Analytics, Settings/Admin - subtracts payment settings (Q21), custom fields, integrations.

nodes.label: Participants (person-level, PDPO purpose-limited)
nodes.rationale: NOT a marketing CRM; registration data was collected to run events not for cold outreach; person-level view derived from event participation, no cold-contact imports, no campaign lists.

nodes.label: Accreditation & Compliance (organiser view)
nodes.rationale: Renamed from CPD Passport per Q29; the wallet is attendee-side, the organiser-side module is event accreditations + body relationships + roster eligibility signals; organisers see outcomes, never edit licences.

nodes.label: Needs-attention queue
nodes.rationale: LoopAI priority-tasks motif; every row is actionable and deep-links to the fix, nothing informational-only; the notification bell must open this same queue, not a second feed.

nodes.label: Per-event readiness strip
nodes.rationale: Cadre motif; one glance answers is this event ready to run (registered fraction, speakers confirmed, accreditation, reminder scheduled, survey armed).

nodes.label: Data presentation rules (intuition layer)
nodes.rationale: Counts live in the chrome; meters/deltas/pills over raw numbers; one-color-one-meaning; tabular-nums right-aligned for regulatory point values; progressive disclosure row-drawer-page; compliance facts repeat wherever the person/event appears.

nodes.label: Eligibility flag (property of the row)
nodes.rationale: Licence lapsed - credits will not post, shown wherever the person appears (roster, check-in, participant list); a lapse discovered at the desk is a credit that silently never posts.
